params.body:
Follows #1070.

**RealGarant codes on the row dealers use**

`real-garant:mapping` matched RealGarant's makes and series to ours by name. When two of our rows normalised to the same name, it kept the oldest, including models merged and switched off in September (R S1-3.22). Such a row carries no vehicles, so a code on it gave the model dealers actually use no warranty offer. On production the run of 7 November 2026 warned about 8 duplicate make keys and 218 duplicate model keys.

What changes:
- The model lookup takes live rows only (`merged_into_id` empty): the switched-on row first, then the oldest. The make lookup takes the switched-on make first.
- A `real_garant_codes` row that an earlier run put on a model that was merged since moves to where that model went (`VehicleModel::destinationOf`). The command prints how many rows it moved.
- No code is written onto a merged row.

**Two names, one model, merged by a person**

Under BAIC, "Beijing X35" (3587) sits beside "X35" (4294), and "Beijing X55" (3588) beside "X55" (4295). Each pair carries the same RealGarant code, and a dealer sees both in the model list. The duplicate merge only groups names that differ in case or spacing, so it cannot find these pairs.

`stocklist:merge-duplicate-models --into=<keep>:<retire>` (repeatable) merges such a pair exactly as a duplicate is merged: vehicles, transports, RealGarant and Modix mappings and dimensions move, and the retired row is switched off and points at the kept one. Nothing guesses:
- every pair is checked first: both rows live, of the same make, of the same type;
- one bad pair writes nothing;
- without `--apply` it is a dry run that shows the vehicle counts.

R S1-3.22 describes both changes.

**After merging, on production**

```
php artisan stocklist:merge-duplicate-models --into=4294:3587 --into=4295:3588
php artisan stocklist:merge-duplicate-models --into=4294:3587 --into=4295:3588 --apply
php artisan real-garant:mapping
```

**Tests**
- `RealGarantMappingLandsOnLiveRowsTest`, with RealGarant faked:
  - a code lands on the live model and not on an older merged row;
  - a mapping on a merged row moves to the survivor and fills its code;
  - of two makes with one name, the switched-on one is matched.
- `MergeDuplicateModelsTest`:
  - `--into` dry run, then apply;
  - refusals: a pair across makes, a pair with an already merged row, a pair of one model with itself, a pair that is not two ids, a missing id; each writes nothing.
- All five new tests fail on main. Full suite: 3217 tests OK. PHPStan is clean on both commands, and Pint passes on the changed and new files.
params.title: A RealGarant code lands on the live model; a person can merge two names into one
